messages:
emily_fin: noticed a strange -$4,500 "partner adjustment" line on CloudNexus invoice INV-2028-0458. AR total is $85,500 but reconciliation shows $90,000. link: https://invoices.redwood.example/INV-2028-0458 :confused:
rajan_sales: CloudNexus is our reseller for that account, right? did they request any credits?
emily_fin: finance has no partner-credit memos on file. the invoice includes both PARTNER_DISCOUNT:-$3,000 and AUTO_PRORATE:-$1,500.
billing-bot: auto-check: INV-2028-0458 matched to commit C-CN-2028Q1. adjustments detected: [PARTNER_DISCOUNT:-3000, AUTO_PRORATE:-1500]. flagged for review. ticket BG-9602 created.
kai_eng: pulling billgen logs now. short excerpt:
```
2028-03-20T11:02:05Z BILLGEN INFO invoice=INV-2028-0458 commit=C-CN-2028Q1 base_amount=90000 adjustments=[{"code":"PARTNER_DISCOUNT","amount":-3000},{"code":"PARTNER_ADJUST","amount":-1500}] total=85500
```
emily_fin: PARTNER_ADJUST vs AUTO_PRORATE mismatch in naming, but amounts match the invoice lines.
rajan_sales: i chatted with CloudNexus rep; they say they submitted a single partner discount via the partner portal on Mar 5 and didn't expect any proration. they also deny issuing an extra adjustment.
kai_eng: suspected bug: when a commit is managed by a reseller (partner_managed=true) and the partner portal sends a discount override, BillGen applied the partner discount and also translated the partner override into an internal partner_adjust during the proration reconciliation step, leading to double credit. opening BG-9602.
emma_cust_ops: invoice is on hold in AR. do not collect. CloudNexus resold this to their end-customer so we need to coordinate messaging carefully.
emily_fin: options: 1) reverse partner_adjust (-$1,500) and reissue invoice (collect difference from reseller), 2) keep credits and address via partner reconciliation. finance leans to reverse the erroneous line and bill reseller for the $1,500 unless partner proves authorization.
rajan_sales: reseller requests a short hold while they audit their portal logs. they prefer we wait 48h before reversing.
kai_eng: hotfix available: dedupe partner adjustments by (partner_id, external_discount_id) during reconciliation. small change, PR ready. if accepted we'll regenerate affected partner-managed invoices.
billing-bot: bg-ticket: BG-9602 assigned to kai_eng. regen-scheduler queued for invoices tagged BG-9602. regen ETA 2028-03-21T04:00:00Z.
emma_cust_ops: guidance request: if CloudNexus already invoiced the end-customer with the double credit, do we coordinate refunds or have them absorb?
emily_fin: finance prefers to reverse on our side and let partner handle downstream; if partner paid us already and it causes cash flow impact we'll coordinate refunds. pre-approve a temporary partner credit cap of $3,500 for remediation while root cause is fixed. document FIN-5899 for auditors.
rajan_sales: i've told CloudNexus we're investigating and asked for portal logs; they responded: "we see only one discount id PT-778, will send evidence."
kai_eng: plan: merge hotfix after 1h CI, deploy to billgen, run regen for partner-managed invoices in the last 30 days, produce a reconciliation report.
billing-bot: CI: billgen/hotfix BG-9602 unit+integration tests passed. deploy scheduled in 45m.
emily_fin: once regen finishes finance will reconcile and then decide whether to lift holds or invoice resellers. please cc finance on any partner comms.
emma_cust_ops: noted. CloudNexus replied: "thanks, awaiting your update. please advise if we should notify our customers."
rajan_sales: will coordinate messaging templates post-regeneration.
emily_fin: final note: no SLA credits involved here; this is reseller pass-through billing logic. keep thread updated with regen results.
